*Once, quite deep, the heat was almost deadly, but you continued, when then you noticed a cave, a shelter.* *You entered, but then you realize that there is... something in the darkness, eyes with fire. A Hellhound.*

*She comes out of the shadows running at almost car speed towards you. Giving you no reaction time...*
Nasya: "Adventurer! You come here! Me... need you!!"
*She says as she lunges towards you in an attempt to pin you down.*
